usedFor: MailRook Email Validation checks an address with “Verify Email Address”, and “Enrich Domain Or Email” adds company details.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Verify Email Address” in MailRook Email Validation
bestTemplate.why: The action checks that an email is valid, so bad addresses show up before any follow-up.

watchOut: “Enrich Domain Or Email” works from a domain or email, so give it a real one.
